# What RSKj's release VETIVER-9.0.4 does with a peg-in it refunds, registered by a transaction and
# by contracts. Each scenario runs two transactions through TransactionExecutor
# (rskj-core-9.0.4-VETIVER-all.jar, regtest, block 10) over the accounts it lists, as
# BlockExecutor runs the sequential sublist of a block, which pays REMASC the fees after the
# last transaction when they come to more than nothing: receiveHeaders from a member of the
# federation, with six Bitcoin headers, then registerBtcTransaction of a payment to the
# federation from a two-of-three multisig, which the second header holds. The
# Bridge starts with an empty list of its federation's UTXOs, and in the scenario low-fee with
# a fee per kilobyte of 10,000 satoshis, under which the refund's fee is bitcoinj's minimum.
# The last scenario registers instead, through the contract that stands for the liquidity
# bridge, a flyover payment over the locking cap, which the Bridge refunds to its user.
# Lines:
#   block    number, gas limit, timestamp, coinbase, difficulty
#   account  address, nonce, balance, code
#   store    a storage cell before the transactions: address, key, value
#   preroot  the state root before the transactions
#   tx       the transaction as RSKj encodes it, its sender, its hash
#   result   whether it was executed, whether it succeeded, the gas it used
#   log      a log it left: address, topics, data
#   itx      an internal transaction of its result: deep, index, note, sender, receiver, value,
#            nonce bytes, gas price, gas limit bytes, data, parent hash, whether it ended
#            rejected, hash
#   cell     the Bridge's storage after both: key, value
#   root     the state root after both
#   enc      an internal transaction built by itself: nonce, gas price, gas limit, sender,
#            receiver, value, data, note, deep, index, parent hash, hash
# A hyphen stands for nothing. Values, balances, gas prices and limits are hex, as every byte
# string is; the block line's numbers, the nonces of account and enc lines, the gas used, deep
# and index are decimal.
block 10 67c280 1700000000 0101010101010101010101010101010101010101 1
# federation address 2MvQSG61B4LtKLECeo1dRDeDWXgJfnr3fC7
# peg-in 747a94a37115c4e28a94af355ee9fc48b1e3e0d671a7b9340b16d6233698d81f
